title: Qualcomm reportedly in advanced talks to acquire AI startup Modular for $4 billion
source_used: The Economic Times (Reuters wire text of 24 Jun 2026) and the Stocktwits pool article; Yahoo Finance (Simply Wall St) for completion.
key_facts: Qualcomm said on Wednesday 24 Jun 2026 that it would buy the AI start-up Modular in an all-stock deal valued at nearly $4 billion (Reuters calculated $3.92 billion).
Qualcomm expected to issue up to 19.2 million shares to Modular's equity holders.
Modular's software runs AI models across chips from different makers without code written for each processor; the deal pits Qualcomm against Nvidia's CUDA platform.
Qualcomm chief executive Cristiano Amon said the future "belongs to developer-friendly, horizontal platforms" that run across different computing environments.
The deal was expected to close in the second half of 2026; Reuters said Qualcomm was also in talks to buy Tenstorrent for $8 billion to $10 billion, per The Information.

Bloomberg first reported the talks on Monday 22 Jun 2026; the Stocktwits article of 10 Oct 2026 repeats that report ("Bloomberg News reported Monday") and says Modular was valued at $1.6 billion nine months earlier.
A Simply Wall St note on Yahoo Finance in late July 2026 says Qualcomm completed the acquisition.
quote_evidence: Qualcomm said on Wednesday it would buy AI startup Modular in an all-stock deal valued at nearly $4 billion, gaining access to software that runs AI models across chips without having to write code for each processor.

The deal, expected to close in the second half of this year, comes as Qualcomm pushes deeper into AI and data-center markets to reduce its reliance on smartphone chips, which generate the bulk of its revenue.
Qualcomm has completed its acquisition of Modular Inc, which provides AI software infrastructure.
why_it_matters_hint: Qualcomm is trying to gain a software answer to Nvidia's CUDA, but the deal was agreed in June.
event_date: 22 Jun 2026 (Bloomberg talks report); 24 Jun 2026 (announced); completion reported late Jul 2026
notes: OLDER NEWS RE-DATED: the Stocktwits article of 10 Oct 2026 repeats the 22 Jun 2026 Bloomberg report of advanced talks, which Qualcomm turned into an announced deal on 24 Jun 2026. Completion rests on one secondary source (Simply Wall St on Yahoo Finance, late Jul 2026), so the entry words it as reported. The Reuters page was not read directly; the Reuters wire text was read on The Economic Times.
